headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
bullets_en: 65% of commuters arrive at Cyberabad IT corridor during peak 90-minute window.
BRS rebuts CM’s allegations against it on AP’s illegal projects.
Aam Aadmi Party and Congress attack SAD-BJP alliance, call it a political arrangement.
High-scoring encounters mark HCA one-day league matches in Hyderabad.
bullets_ur: Cyberabad IT corridor aane walay 65feesad musafir 90minute ke peak waqt mein pohanchtay hain.
BRS ne AP ke ghair qanooni projects par CM ke ilzamat ko radd kar diya
Aam Aadmi Party aur Congress ne SAD-BJP alliance par hamla kiya hai aur isay aik siyasi samjhota qarar diya hai.
Hyderabad mein HCA one-day league matchon ke douran ziyada score walay muqablay dekhne ko milay.
